title: Analysis code for: Skeletal-muscle phenotype and GC/MS metabolome dataset from mice fed a baked high-AGE diet with or without coffee intake
description: Python scripts that reproduce every statistic and figure of the Data in Brief article from the deposited processed data files. Running the five scripts in order regenerates the deposited derived tables and the article figures.
